flags.title: The IRN window is closing
flags.detail: 17 invoice(s) are within a week of the 30-day registration deadline. After it the portal refuses them outright, and an invoice without an IRN is not legally valid.
flags.ask: Which invoices are close to the 30-day e-invoice deadline, and what happens if we miss it?

flags.title: Payments sitting on account
flags.detail: 3 payment(s) hold ₹3,75,000 that has not been matched to any invoice. The customer looks like they still owe it.
flags.ask: Which customers have paid money that is not yet applied to an invoice?

flags.title: Bank lines not reconciled
flags.detail: 2 statement line(s) have not been matched to anything. Until they are, the bank balance in the books is not the balance in the bank.
flags.ask: What is our cash position today, and how much of it is still unreconciled?
